speaker: Narrator
text: You set off on your journey... The first half an hour go by relatively peaceful

speaker: You
text: Okay... first proper drive on my own.

speaker: Monty
text: Woof!

speaker: You
text: Haha, you're excited too, aren't you?

speaker: Narrator
text: The road winds through the hills, with forests and ocean stretching outwards.

speaker: You
text: It's actually really pretty out here.

speaker: Narrator
text: Suddenly, something steps onto the road.

speaker: You
text: Wait... is that a pūkeko?

speaker: Narrator
text: The pūkeko moves further onto the road.

speaker: You
text: Oh no!

speaker: Narrator
text: Time seems to slow.

speaker: You
text: ...Huh?

speaker: Narrator
text: For a moment, the sound of the engine fades.

speaker: You
text: That's... strange.

speaker: Narrator
text: A faint melody drifts through the air.

speaker: You
text: Am I hearing music?

speaker: Narrator
text: The pūkeko looks towards the car before quickly running into the roadside brush.

speaker: You
text: Are you okay?

speaker: Narrator
text: The pūkeko disappears into the vegetation.

speaker: You
text: I think it's fine...

speaker: You
text: That was way too close.

speaker: Narrator
text: The sound of the engine returns.

speaker: You
text: Okay. I'll pay more attention.
